data.text: **Qaa'ida (Pages 14–15):** Qur'an Majeed ke hazaron alfaaz Urdu/Hinglish mein pehle hi se ma'roof hain. Arbi mein kisi ism ke shuru mein **`الْـ`** lagane se woh lafz **khaas (*Ma'rifah*)** ho jata hai aur uske aakhri harf par Tanween ke bajaye **ek Pesh (`ـُ`)** aata hai (`الْإِسْلَامُ`، `الْقُرْآنُ`، `الْحَقُّ`).
Qur'an mein baar baar aane wale aasaan alfaaz. Inke matlab samjhein:

Arabi zaban mein [ اَلْ ] ka matlab 'khaas' (English mein 'The') hota hai, aur yeh un alfaaz ke shuru mein lagta hai jinka mafhoom khaas ('The') ho. Khaas logon ke naamon (maslan: مُحَمَّدٌ, مُوسَىٰ, فِرْعَوْن) ke shuru mein aam taur par [ اَلْ ] nahi aata. Agar iss sabaq ya aane wale asbaaq mein koi naya lafz mile, toh aasaani ke liye use highlight kar lein.
data.hinglish_text: Arabi zaban mein [ اَلْ ] ka matlab “yeh” (khaas) hota hai, aur yeh un alfaaz ke shuru mein lagta hai jinka matlab “yeh” ho. items.hinglish: Aur beshak woh bhalai (maal) ki muhabbat mein bohot sakht hai

data.text: **Qaa'ida (Pages 16–17):** Jin Arbi alfaaz ke aakhir mein **Gol Taa (`ة / ـة`)** hoti hai (Jaise `الصَّلَاةُ`، `الْجَنَّةُ`، `الرَّحْمَةُ`، `الْآخِرَةُ`، `الْقِيَامَةُ`), woh **Mu'annas (Feminine)** hote hain.
Aap darj zail Quranic alfaaz ko bhi aasaani se samajh sakte hain. Di gayi jagahon mein inke maani likhein:
Jin alfaaz ke aakhir mein gol 'ta' [ة / ـة] hoti hai, woh muannath (feminine) hote hain. Gaur karein ke iss sabaq aur pichle sabaq mein kaun kaun se alfaaz muannath hain?

data.text: **Qaa'ida (Pages 18–19):** Lafz se lafz mil kar qat'ah aur jumla banta hai. Is sabaq ke 36 ma'roof Qur'ani alfaaz (`الْقِبْلَةُ`، `الشَّفَاعَةُ`، `الْأَمَانَةُ`، `الْهِدَايَةُ`، `الطَّاقَةُ`) yaad kar lene se saikdon aayatein aasan ho jati hain.
Pichle do asbaaq ki tarah, aap in alfaaz ke maani bhi jaante honge. Nisbatan naye alfaaz ke maani samne likh diye gaye hain:

Lafz se lafz mil kar jumla banta hai. Quran-e-Pak ki aayatein bhi mukhtalif jumle hain. Jis tarah ab aap alfaaz samajhne lage hain, usi tarah In Sha' Allah bohot jald Quran-e-Pak ki aayatein bhi samajhne lagenge.

data.text: **Qaa'ida (Pages 22–23):** Is sabaq mein ajr, maghfirat, taqwa aur aakhirat se muta'alliq 36 aham Qur'ani asmaa aur 12 Qur'ani aayatein shamil hain.
Darj zail Qur'ani alfaaz ke ma'ani aam taur par aap jaante honge. Nisbatan naye alfaaz ke ma'ani unke saath de diye gaye hain. Faraham karda jagahon mein inke matlab likhein:

Kya aapne kabhi socha hai ke kitne 'parhe likhe Musalman' apni poori zindagi Qur'an ko samajhne ki koshish kiye baghair guzaar dete hain. Aaj apne aap se ahad karein ke aap Arabi seekhne ki jadd-o-jehad karenge taake Allah Ta'ala ka paigham samajh sakein. In Sha' Allah!

data.text: **Qaa'ida (Pages 24–25):** Jab kisi ism ke shuru mein `الْـ` aata hai toh aam halat mein uske aakhri harf par **ek Pesh (`ـُ`)** aata hai (`الْكَبِيرُ`، `الْعَظِيمُ`، `الْمُسْتَقِيمُ`).
Darj zail alfaaz ke samne unke maani likhein. Nisbatan naye alfaaz ke maani darj kar diye gaye hain:

Agar kisi lafz ke shuru mein [ اَلْـ ] aaye, toh aam taur par uske aakhiri harf par Pesh (Dammah) [ ُ ] aata hai, jaise [ اَلرَّحْمٰنُ ]. Lekin jumle ke hisaab se aakhir mein Zabar (Fatha) [ َ ] ya Zer (Kasrah) [ ِ ] bhi aa sakti hai. iss se lafz ke maani par koi farq nahi padta.
Ab aap darj zail Qur'ani fiqron aur aayaton ko khud samajh aur tarjuma kar sakte hain.
**Exercise (Practice):** Darj zail Qur'ani aayaton mein se un alfaaz ko highlight karein jinhe aap mukammal taur par samajhte hain:

translations.ur: مال اور بیٹے دنیا کی زندگی کی زینت ہیں
translations.en: Wealth and children are the adornment of the worldly life

items.arabic_markup: وَزَادَهُ بَسْطَةً فِي الْعِلْمِ وَالْجِسْمِ
items.hinglish: Aur use ilm aur jism mein kushadgi di

translations.ur: اور اسے علم اور جسم میں کشادگی دی
translations.en: And increased him abundantly in knowledge and stature
translations.hi: और उसे इल्म और जिस्म में कुशादगी दी

items.hinglish: Main tumhein najaat ki taraf bulata hoon

translations.ur: میں تمہیں نجات کی طرف بلاتا ہوں
translations.hi: मैं तुम्हें नजात की तरफ़ बुलाता हूँ

items.arabic_markup: فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ الْبَلَاغُ وَعَلَيْنَا الْحِسَابُ

translations.en: Upon you is only the notification, and upon Us is the account

items.hinglish: Allah ki taraf se ek farz

translations.ur: اللہ کی طرف سے ایک فرض
translations.hi: अल्लाह की तरफ़ से एक फ़र्ज़

items.hinglish: Aur woh logon ko kanjoosi ka hukm dete hain

translations.ur: اور وہ لوگوں کو کنجوسی کا حکم دیتے ہیں
translations.en: And enjoin upon the people stinginess
translations.hi: और वे लोगों को कंजूसी का हुक्म देते हैं

items.arabic_markup: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَى هَذَا الْفَتْحُ

translations.en: And they say, 'When is this conquest?'
translations.hi: और वे कहते हैं यह फ़तह कब होगी?

items.hinglish: Main toh sirf sudhaar chahta hoon

translations.ur: میں تو صرف اصلاح چاہتا ہوں
translations.hi: मैं तो सिर्फ़ सुधार चाहता हूँ

items.arabic: شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ الَّذِي أُنْزِلَ فِيهِ الْقُرْآنُ
items.arabic_markup: شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ الَّذِي أُنْزِلَ فِيهِ الْقُرْآنُ

data.text: Some More Well-Known Qur'anic Words — Mazeed Mashhoor Qur'ani Alfaaz
Pichle sabaqat ki tarah, iss sabaq mein bhi Quran-e-Majeed ke aasan alfaaz shamil hain jinhe aap khud samajh sakte hain. Jo alfaaz nisbatan naye hain unke maani de diye gaye hain.

Kya aapne kabhi doosre mazameen (subjects) seekhne mein itni mehnat ki hai jitni Quran seekhne mein karte hain? Nahi? Toh aaj hi se faisla karein ke apni poori mehnat aur waqt Quran ke liye lagayenge. Allah aapke saath hai.
Iss kitaab ki tamaam misaalein Quran-e-Kareem se hain. Kitna achha ho agar aap ise baa-wuzu hokar parhein?
Exercise — Qur'anic Aayaat
Darj zail Quranic aayaton mein se un alfaaz par ghaur karein jinhe aap mukammal taur par samajhte hain:

items.arabic_markup: وَلَا تَسْتَوِي الْحَسَنَةُ وَلَا السَّيِّئَةُ
items.hinglish: Neki aur burai barabar nahi ho sakti.

translations.ur: نیکی اور برائی برابر نہیں ہو سکتی
translations.en: And not equal are the good deed and the bad
translations.hi: नेकी और बुराई बराबर नहीं हो सकती

items.hinglish: Aur woh unhein kitaab aur hikmat sikhata hai.

translations.ur: اور وہ انہیں کتاب اور حکمت سکھاتا ہے
translations.en: And teaches them the Book and wisdom
translations.hi: और वह उन्हें किताब और हिकमत सिखाता है

items.hinglish: Aur agar aapko kisi qaum se khiyaanat ka darr ho.

translations.ur: اور اگر آپ کو کسی قوم سے خیانت کا ڈر ہو
translations.en: And if you fear from a people betrayal
translations.hi: और अगर आपको किसी क़ौम से ख़ियानत का डर हो

items.arabic_markup: وَاللَّهُ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ
items.hinglish: Aur Allah bade fazl wala hai.

translations.ur: اور اللہ بڑے فضل والا ہے
translations.en: And Allah is the possessor of great bounty
translations.hi: और अल्लाह बड़े फ़ज़्ल वाला है

items.hinglish: Naapaak aur paak barabar nahi ho sakte.

translations.ur: ناپاک اور پاک برابر نہیں ہو سکتے
translations.en: Not equal are the evil and the good
translations.hi: नापाक और पाक बराबर नहीं हो सकते

items.hinglish: Magar Hazrat Yaqoob (Alaihis Salam) ke dil mein ek zaroorat thi jo unhone poori ki.

translations.ur: مگر حضرت یعقوب علیہ السلام کے دل میں ایک ضرورت تھی
translations.en: Except a need within the soul of Jacob
translations.hi: मगर हज़रत याक़ूब (अलैहिस्सलाम) के दिल में एक ज़रूरत थी

items.arabic_markup: وَمَا كَانَ اسْتِغْفَارُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ لِأَبِيهِ
items.hinglish: Aur Hazrat Ibrahim (Alaihis Salam) ka apne baap ke liye bakhshish maangna sirf ek waade ki wajah se tha.

translations.ur: اور حضرت ابراہیم علیہ السلام کا اپنے باپ کے لیے بخشش مانگنا...
translations.en: And the request of forgiveness of Abraham for his father was not...
translations.hi: और हज़रत इब्राहीम (अलैहिस्सलाम) का अपने बाप के लिए बख़्शिश माँगना...

items.arabic: إِنِّي تَرَكْتُ مِلَّةَ قَوْمٍ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ
items.arabic_markup: إِنِّي تَرَكْتُ مِلَّةَ قَوْمٍ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ
items.hinglish: Beshak main ne un logon ka tareeqah chhod diya jo Allah par imaan nahi rakhte.

translations.ur: بیشک میں نے ان لوگوں کا طریقہ چھوڑ دیا جو اللہ پر ایمان نہیں رکھتے
translations.en: Indeed, I have left the religion of a people who do not believe in Allah
translations.hi: बेशक मैंने उन लोगों का तरीक़ा छोड़ दिया जो अल्लाह पर ईमान नहीं रखते

items.hinglish: Aur raat aur din ke badalne mein.

translations.ur: اور رات اور دن کے بدلنے میں
translations.en: And the alternation of the night and the day
translations.hi: और रात और दिन के बदलने में

items.arabic_markup: وَمَنْ كَانَ فَقِيرًا فَلْيَأْكُلْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ
items.hinglish: Aur jo zarooratmand ho toh woh dastoor ke mutabiq khaa le.

translations.ur: اور جو ضرورت مند ہو تو وہ دستور کے مطابق کھا لے
translations.en: And whoever is poor — let him take according to what is acceptable
translations.hi: और जो ज़रूरतमंद हो तो वह दस्तूर के मुताबिक़ खा ले

items.hinglish: Kisi maa ko uske bachche ki wajah se takleef na di jaye.

translations.ur: کسی ماں کو اس کے بچے کی وجہ سے تکلیف نہ دی جائے
translations.en: No mother should be harmed through her child
translations.hi: किसी माँ को उसके बच्चे की वजह से तकलीफ़ न दी जाए

items.arabic_markup: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَذَا الْوَعْدُ
items.hinglish: Aur woh kehte hain ke yeh waada kab poora hoga?

translations.ur: اور وہ کہتے ہیں کہ یہ وعدہ کب پورا ہوگا؟

data.text: **Qaa'ida (Pages 32–33):** Jin jama alfaaz mein wahid lafz ki tarteeb toot kar naye huroof judte hain unhein **Jama Mukassar** kehte hain (`قَلَمٌ ← أَقْلَامٌ`، `عَمَلٌ ← أَعْمَالٌ`، `قَلْبٌ ← قُلُوبٌ`، `مَسْجِدٌ ← مَسَاجِدُ`). Yeh alfaaz Urdu mein bhi aam istemal hote hain.
Asaan Arabi Jama Alfaaz (Broken Plurals / Jama Mukassar)
Neeche diye gaye jama ke alfaaz samajhne mein asaan hain. Aap ki sahulat ke liye naye alfaaz ke wahid (singular) bhi saath mein zikr kiye gaye hain.
Yeh jama ke alfaaz Qur'an-e-Majeed mein baar baar aate hain. Inhe achhi tarah yaad karein aur [الـ] ke saath mila kar buland aawaz se padhne ki koshish karein.
Arabi zaban mein jama ke alfaaz aam taur par muannath (feminine) shumar hote hain. Upar zikr kiye gaye tamam jama alfaaz muannath hain.

Kuch Aur Qur'ani Jama ke Alfaaz (Jama Muannath Saalim — Suffix ات)

Bahut se jama ke alfaaz hain jo [ا] aur [ت] par khatam hote hain jaise [الْجَنَّاتُ] aur [الْبَرَكَاتُ]. Yeh Qur'ani alfaaz aam taur par cheezon ke majmoo'e ya auraton ke giroh ka matlab dete hain. Darj zail alfaaz ko dhyan se padhiye aur unke ma'ani samjhiye.
Yeh alfaaz yaad kar lein. Alfaaz ke aakhir mein (ات) unhe doosre jama ke alfaaz se alag karta hai aur yeh Qur'an-e-Majeed mein bahut kasrat se aate hain.
Agar yeh jama ke alfaaz (الـ) se shuru na hon toh unke aakhiri harf par tanween aayegi. Jaise (الْآيَاتُ) se (آيَاتٌ). Tamam alfaaz ko shuru mein (الـ) ke baghair padh kar exercise kijiye.

data.text: **Qaa'ida (Pages 42–43):** **`هَٰذَا`** ka matlab **'Yeh'** (muzakkar) hai. Agar `هَٰذَا` ke baad **Tanween (`ـٌ`)** wala lafz aaye toh **mukammal jumla** banta hai (`هَٰذَا كِتَابٌ` = Yeh ek kitaab hai). Aur agar `هَٰذَا` ke baad **`الْـ`** wala lafz aaye toh sirf **adhoora qat'ah** banta hai (`هَٰذَا الْقُرْآنُ` = Yeh Qur'an).
Darj zail misaalon par ghaur karein:

(هٰذَا) ka matlab Arabic mein 'yeh' (this) hai. (هٰذَا) aur tanween wala lafz milkar ek mukammal aur saada jumla banate hain. (هٰذَا) Arabic mein qareeb ki cheez ki taraf ishaarah karne ke liye istemal hota hai. Aap pehle hi jaan chuke hain ke lafz par tanween aam taur par 'hai' ke mafhoom mein aati hai.
Darj zail alfaaz aur jumlon ka tarjuma kijiye:

translations.en: And this is a tongue / language
This is a slander / false accusation

data.text: Agar (هٰذَا) ke baad aane wala lafz (الْـ) se shuru ho, toh yeh mukammal jumla nahi banta kyunke (هٰذَا) aur agla lafz milkar ek hi cheez banate hain jaise (هٰذَا الْكِتَابُ). Aisi soorat mein yeh do alfaaz aam taur par kisi doosre jumle ka hissa hote hain. iss baat ko behtar samajhne ke liye 'Yeh' aur 'Kitaab' do lafz milkar jumla nahi balke ek murakkab (phrase) banate hain jo jumle mein faa'il ya maf'ool ban sakta hai. (مَتَىٰ) ka matlab 'kab' (when) hai aur iske saath milkar ek mukammal jumla banta hai. Niche diye gaye do jumlon ka tarjuma aap khud kijiye:

data.text: **Qaa'ida (Pages 44–45):** **`ذَٰلِكَ`** ka matlab **'Woh'** (aur azmat ya ta'keed ke liye **'Yeh / Yahi'**) hota hai: `ذَٰلِكَ كِتَابٌ` (Woh kitaab hai), `ذَٰلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ` (Yahi badi kamyaabi hai).
Darj zail misaalon par ghaur karein:

(ذٰلِكَ) aam taur par Arabic mein door ki cheez ki taraf ishaarah karne ke liye istemal hota hai, jabke (هٰذَا) qareeb ke liye hota hai. (ذٰلِكَ) ke baad aam taur par tanween wala lafz aata hai jisse ek mukammal jumla banta hai. Darj zail jumlon ko samjhein aur tarjuma kijiye:

translations.en: That is Jesus (peace be upon him)

data.text: Guftagu mein (ذٰلِكَ) aam taur par door ki cheez ki taraf ishaarah karne ke liye istemal hota hai, lekin Quran-e-Kareem mein yeh aksar qareeb ki cheez ke liye bhi 'yeh' (this) ke ma'na mein aata hai. Upar diye gaye jumlon ka tarjuma aapne 'woh' se kiya hai, ab inhein 'yeh' ke ma'na mein samajhein jaise ﴿ذٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ﴾ 'Yeh behtar hai'.

(ذٰلِكَ) ke baad agar aisa lafz aaye jo (الْـ) se shuru hota ho toh uske do mafhoom bante hain: 1. Yeh ek murakkab (phrase) banta hai jaise (ذٰلِكَ الْكِتَابُ). Aisi soorat mein jumla mukammal nahi hota, iss liye 'hai' nahi aayega. Pehle misaal ke mutabiq baaqi Quranic murakkabaat ka tarjuma kijiye:

2. Yeh ek mukammal jumla bhi banta hai jisme taakeed (emphasis) maqsood hoti hai, jaise darj zail Quranic jumlon mein dekha ja sakta hai. Aayat ke siyaaq-o-sabaaq se aap samajh sakte hain ke kaunsa mafhoom munasib hai:

translations.en: That indeed is the correct religion

data.text: **Qaa'ida (Pages 48–49):** Ism ke shuru mein Zabar wala Laam (**`لَـ`**) lagane se ma'ni mein **'Yaqeenan / Zaroor'** (*Laam-e-Ta'keed*) ka izafa hota hai aur ism ki aakhri harkat (`ـٌ / ـُ`) nahin badalti (jabke `لِـ` Zair deta hai): `لَقُرْآنٌ كَرِيمٌ` (yaqeenan ba-izzat Qur'an hai), `لَلْحَقُّ` (yaqeenan haq hi hai).
Darj zail misaalein dekhein:

Upar di gayi misaalon mein pehle column ke teen alfaaz (الْـ) ke baghair hain. Agle column mein unhi alfaaz ke shuru mein (لَـ) laga hua hai. Kisi lafz ke shuru mein (لَـ) lagaane se us mein 'yaqeenan', 'beshak' ya 'bila-shuba' ke ma'ani paida ho jaate hain. iss tarah poore lafz ka ma'ana 'yaqeenan woh ek ... hai' hota hai. (لَـ) wala lafz aam taur par jumle ke aakhir mein aata hai. Aise alfaaz Qur'an-e-Kareem mein bakasrat istemal hue hain.
Ab aap darj zail jumlon ko khud samajh kar tarjuma kar sakte hain:

Ta'keed ka (لَـ) baaz auqaat un alfaaz ke shuru mein bhi aata hai jo (الْـ) se shuru hote hain. Aisi soorat mein (الْـ) ka alif gir jaata hai aur dono laam aapas mein mil jaate hain (jaise الْـ + لَـ = لَلْـ) aur tarjuma mein 'yaqeenan' ka izafa hota hai. Darj zail Qur'ani jumlon ko samjhein aur tarjuma karein:

Yeh ta'keed ka (لَـ) Qur'an-e-Majeed mein mukhtalif alfaaz ke saath kasrat se istemal hota hai aur iss se kalaam mein shadeed ta'keed (zor) paida hota hai. Aane wale sabaqon mein tarjuma karte waqt iss baat ko achhi tarah zehen mein rakhein.

data.text: **Qaa'ida (Page 50):** Kisi sifat mein muwazana (**'zyada ...' ya 'sabse ...'**) paida karne ke liye 3-harfi maadde se pehle **`أَ`** lagaya jata hai (**`أَفْعَلُ`** wazan), aur is par Tanween nahin aati (sirf ek Pesh `ـُ` aata hai): `كَبِيرٌ ← أَكْبَرُ` (sabse bada), `عَلِيمٌ ← أَعْلَمُ` (sabse zyada jaanne wala), `حَسَنٌ ← أَحْسَنُ` (sabse behtar). Do alfaaz `خَيْرٌ` (behtar) aur `شَرٌّ` (bad-tar) baghair `أَ` ke isi ma'ni mein aate hain.
Darj zail alfaaz par ghaur karein, unki banawat aur ma'ani ko dekhein:

Upar diye gaye alfaaz mein chand baatein mushtarak (ek jaisi) hain: Har lafz chaar huroof par mushtamil hai, har lafz ke shuru mein (أَ) hai, aur sab par aaraab (harakat) ek jaise hain. Arabi mein iss wazan (أَفْعَلُ) par aane wale alfaaz Ism-e-Tafzeel (Superlative) hote hain, jin mein kisi sift ki inteha ya sabse zyada hone ka ma'ana paida hota hai. Yeh alfaaz logon ke naamon ke taur par bhi aam istemal hote hain, jaise Akram (sabse ba-izzat) ya Afzal (sabse behtar).
Ab aap darj zail alfaaz ko khud samajh sakte hain:

translations.ur: سب سے زیادہ باقی رہنے والا
سب سے قریب / سب سے کمتر
سب سے برا / سب سے بڑا شر
